yarn-dinkum.meaning: All facts kept: three F-5s, the Jets vs Browns game, the 10 to 1 Experience Zone, Artemis dome, inflatable SLS, MAX POWER on Nov. 7 and 8, the 250th anniversary. Additions are colour: "Now here's one for the gridiron fans.", "roaring over to kick off".
yarn-dinkum.sense: Terms fit their context: "at the stick of one of three F-5 fighter jets", "having a yarn with the fans", "the uni mob" for academia, "driverless vehicles" for autonomous vehicles, "down the track" for the future.
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural Australian: "a whopping great inflatable", "have a crack at the hands-on games", "a multi-day do", "down the track". One US form: "public sector folks".
yarn-dinkum.register: Right about level 4: most sentences retold in Aussie ("The Inspiration Tour's pulling up all over the country", "The whole show wraps up") without tipping into a pub yarn. No swearing, within vulgarity 1.
yarn-dinkum.tone: Keeps the upbeat promotional tone of the release: "it's a multi-day do that's good for the whole family, showing off the next-gen aircraft".
yarn-dinkum.flow: Reads well; the last sentence is long ("Put on to honour America's historic 250th anniversary, it's a multi-day do that's good for the whole family, showing off").
yarn-dinkum.variety: Varied throughout: "at the stick", "roaring over", "having a yarn", "pop under", "have a crack", "snap a few pics", "uni mob", "hook the agency up", "wraps up", "know-how".
yarn-dinkum.essence: Unmistakably the NASA flyover notice, same order and content: "MAX POWER, a public expo of American air and space know-how".

dinkum-4.meaning: All facts kept in the original order: "to get the New York Jets vs. Cleveland Browns game underway", "from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. EDT", "on Saturday, Nov. 7, and Sunday, Nov. 8". Nothing invented.
dinkum-4.sense: Mostly apt ("at the controls", "having a yarn", "a big blow-up SLS", "down the track"), but "a public show-and-tell of American air and space know-how" shrinks an exposition to a classroom activity, and "rock up under the agency's Artemis dome" is a slightly odd fit for going inside.
dinkum-4.authenticity: Natural throughout: "the academic, industry and public sector mob", "have a go at the hands-on games", "the multi-day, family-friendly do". Nothing American left in.
dinkum-4.register: A shade lighter than level 4: the first sentence is nearly the original, and terms like "next-generation aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous vehicles and technologies" are kept as written. No swearing.
dinkum-4.tone: Keeps the promotional tone: "so the agency can link up with the people, technologies and organisations that keep America out in front in space."
dinkum-4.flow: Reads smoothly, like it was written that way: "With stops right round the country, NASA’s Inspiration Tour gets the academic, industry and public sector mob together".
dinkum-4.variety: Varied: "at the controls", "having a yarn", "rock up", "have a go", "snap a few pics", "mob", "show-and-tell", "down the track".
dinkum-4.essence: Clearly the original release, retold: "The whole tour wraps up with MAX POWER".

dinkum-3.meaning: All facts kept: "fly one of three F-5 fighter jets himself", "from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. EDT", "on Saturday, Nov. 7, and Sunday, Nov. 8". "gridiron game" is a gloss for Aussie readers; "out the front of the stadium" is a slight narrowing of "outside".
dinkum-3.sense: Terms fit: "having a yarn with the fans", "grab a happy snap", "public sector players", "the next lot of aircraft", "down the track".
dinkum-3.authenticity: Good Aussie in places ("a happy snap", "a whopping great blow-up SLS", "keep the Yanks out in front"), but US forms and a stagey opener: "Okay, so." and "is gonna fly".
dinkum-3.register: About level 4: the narrative is retold throughout ("It all winds up with MAX POWER", "the multi-day, family-friendly do'll show off"). No swearing.
dinkum-3.tone: The promotional tone mostly holds; "keep the Yanks out in front in space" adds a faintly ironic outsider's edge to a NASA release.
dinkum-3.flow: Mostly smooth, but it starts with a jarring "Okay, so. As part of the agency's Inspiration Tour flyover".
dinkum-3.variety: Varied: "having a yarn", "Pop under", "have a crack", "happy snap", "whopping great", "hooking the agency up", "winds up", "next lot".
dinkum-3.essence: Unmistakably the original release, retold: "MAX POWER, a public expo of American air and space know-how".

yarn-dinkum.why: "folks" is American; an Australian would say people or mob.

dinkum-4.quote: a public show-and-tell of American air and space know-how
dinkum-4.original: a public exposition of American air and space innovation
dinkum-4.why: "show-and-tell" belittles a national exposition; a slightly wrong sense.

dinkum-4.quote: Fans can rock up under the agency’s Artemis dome
dinkum-4.original: Fans can learn more about NASA’s return to the Moon under the agency’s Artemis dome
dinkum-4.why: "rock up" means arrive, a slightly odd fit for going under a dome.

dinkum-3.why: "gonna" is an American form an Australian writer would not use here.
A stagey, American-sounding opener bolted on; jars at the start.

dinkum-3.quote: keep the Yanks out in front in space
dinkum-3.why: "the Yanks" gives the release an outsider's wry edge it doesn't have.

summaries.yarn-dinkum: Lively, natural and accurate, at the right level-4 weight; the best of the three.
summaries.dinkum-4: Smooth, faithful and natural, a touch lighter than level 4, with one belittling choice in "show-and-tell".
summaries.dinkum-3: Right weight and good idiom in places, let down by "gonna", a bolted-on opener and a slight tonal edge.
